adapterMissing.zh-CN: 通知 adapter 命令不可用：{command}。本次会话已停用系统通知。
adapterMissing.en-US: Notification adapter command is unavailable: {command}. System notifications are disabled for this session.

sendFailed.zh-CN: 通知 adapter 执行失败：{command}（{reason}）。本次会话已停用系统通知。
sendFailed.en-US: Notification adapter failed: {command} ({reason}). System notifications are disabled for this session.

configInvalid.zh-CN: 通知配置读取失败：{path}（{reason}）。已使用默认配置。
configInvalid.en-US: Failed to read notification config: {path} ({reason}). Default configuration is being used.

configCommandDescription.zh-CN: 配置系统通知（参数为 JSON，省略参数时进入编辑）
configCommandDescription.en-US: Configure system notifications (pass JSON, or omit it to edit interactively)

configCommandInput.zh-CN: 输入完整的通知配置 JSON（输入 reset 恢复默认值）
configCommandInput.en-US: Enter the complete notification configuration JSON (or reset for defaults)

configCommandInteractiveOnly.zh-CN: 无交互界面时请直接传入配置 JSON。
configCommandInteractiveOnly.en-US: Pass configuration JSON directly when no interactive UI is available.

configCommandSaved.zh-CN: 通知配置已保存：{path}。请执行 /reload 使配置生效。
configCommandSaved.en-US: Notification configuration saved to {path}. Run /reload to apply it.
